resourcePolicy.profilePolicy: One fresh headful Edge context/profile/page and loopback server per root, serial; variable internal Edge process count.
resourcePolicy.memoryDisk: No hard RAM or profile-disk cap. Retain all outputs; logs capped at1MiB each and receipt4MiB. Parent coordinates quiet Windows resource availability.

reviewScope.scope: Read-only additive worker/controller, original host/reader/runner receipts and arithmetic. No qualification or visible-game evidence.
reviewScope.resolved: Atomic launch publication; missing-receipt strict app-only recovery; five-second record reserve; minimum grant arithmetic; post-publication deadline receipt.
reviewScope.limits: Native job operation/cleanup bounded. Controller final disk I/O checks are cooperative, so blocked I/O is not a hard whole-controller deadline proof. Independent desktop release required for a future run.
